toolDir.label: video_chapters Tool Directory
toolDir.help: Absolute path to the folder containing video_chapters.exe (and its bundled ffmpeg/whisper subfolders). Windows ARM64 only.

watchDirs.label: Startup Batch-Index Directories
watchDirs.help: Absolute directory paths to scan for .mp4 files on gateway startup and keep summarized + indexed. Leave empty to disable startup batch indexing entirely.

embeddings.baseUrl.label: Embeddings Base URL
embeddings.baseUrl.help: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (e.g. a local llama-server --embedding instance).

embeddings.apiKey.label: Embeddings API Key
embeddings.apiKey.help: Any non-empty string for a local server that does not check it.

embeddings.dimensions.label: Embeddings Dimensions
embeddings.dimensions.help: Vector size returned by the embeddings model (BGE-M3 is 1024).
